notes: The parts below are for the CDMA variant (USA and Canada). The CPAP, Elite, AutoSet and AutoSet For Her variants are covered.

gaps: The later CPAP filings were not checked and may carry other modems.
It gives heater plate temperatures but no heater wattage, and calls the display a screen without naming its type.
Next to the MCU sits an ISSI chip whose part number is not fully legible.

The main board also carries a shielded block with two ports and a single-port package beside silkscreen Sensor502, neither with a legible part number; the sensor claim uses the user guide's description.
The coin cell's brand print is only partly legible, so no brand is claimed.
method: FCC exhibits were read through the fccid.io mirror (fccid.io/pdf.php?id=...) because apps.fcc.gov and fcc.report returned HTTP 403.

The internal-photo exhibit (6 pages, checked 2026-11-12) is from the original 2014 CDMA filing 2ACHL-AIR10CD (grant 2014-07-17) and shows the FG Main PCBA R370-7326 (silkscreen R370-7325 Rev1.0) and the CAM PCBA R379-748.
The user guide filed with it lists the wireless module as CDMA (USA and Canada) and gives this FCC ID.
ResMed's fccid.io grantee list shows later CPAP filings (2ACHL-A10STACD, 2ACHL-AIR103G, 2ACHL-A10STA3G, 2ACHL-AIR104G, 2ACHL-AIR104GU).
The user guide is ResMed doc 378120 rev 2 (AirSense 10 with humidifier, AMER, July 2014).
In the iFixit pump guide the heater plate's orange wire is disconnected from a fuse, and a plastic heater plate cover is held by four Torx T10 screws.
ResMed's own document server (document.resmed.com) refused the research fetcher (HTTP 403), so it was skipped.

comps.spec: ResMed 90 W external power supply unit: AC input 100-240 V 50-60 Hz 1.0-1.5 A (Class II), DC output 24 V 3.75 A; whole device typical draw 53 W, peak 104 W
Pressure sensor at the device outlet, analog gauge type, -5 to +45 cm H2O; flow sensor at the device inlet, digital mass-flow type, -70 to +180 L/min
Humidifier heater plate: maximum plate temperature 68 C, cut-out 74 C; water tub holds 380 mL to the maximum fill line
Air tubing options: SlimLine 1.8 m, 15 mm inner diameter; Standard 2 m, 19 mm inner diameter; ClimateLineAir heated tube 2 m, 15 mm inner diameter with 41 C cut-out; 22 mm air outlet

Inlet air filter: standard polyester non-woven (over 75% arrestance at about 7 micron) or hypoallergenic acrylic/polypropylene fibre (over 98% at about 7-8 micron, over 80% at about 0.5 micron); not washable
Blower (pump assembly) wrapped in a rubber sock on a mounting plate inside a pump casing closed by three Torx T10 screws; one wire connector to the main board
FG Main PCBA R370-7326 (silkscreen R370-7325 Rev1.0, ResMed 2014): ST STM32F405ZGT6 MCU, ISSI chip, buzzer (BZ200), coin cell, SD card slot and the screen on the display side
ST STM32F405ZGT6 Arm microcontroller (marked STM32F405ZGT6), quad flat package on the CPU side of the main PCBA
CAM PCBA R379-748 carrying a Telit CE910-DUAL cellular module (module FCC ID RI7CE910-DUAL), with an inductor and two electrolytic capacitors; joined to the main board by a 4-wire lead
Coin cell with solder tabs at BAT200 on the main PCBA
Screen mounted on the display side of the main PCBA
